title: Slovakian-Italian Roast Pork
description: Slow-roasted pork shoulder infused with Slovakian zesty flavors and Italian seasonings.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and italian seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and potatoes to the pot. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the paprika to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the pork shoulder to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 2-3 hours, or until the pork is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the pork rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
